stem: If an adult patient is taking high-dose or prolonged corticosteroids, how long should live vaccines be deferred after stopping the medication?
explanation: A one-month gap allows the immune system to recover from the suppressive effects of the steroids, ensuring both safety and a better vaccine response.
rationale: This timeframe is consistent with the window used to ensure the immune system has regained functional status.

optionExplanations.A: A one-month gap allows the immune system to recover from the suppressive effects of the steroids, ensuring both safety and a better vaccine response.
optionExplanations.B: Corticosteroids have lingering effects on immune function that last much longer than one day.
optionExplanations.C: While some biological drugs require a six-month wait, the standard recommendation for steroids is a shorter one-month interval.
optionExplanations.D: A full year is excessively long for steroid-induced immunosuppression unless other complicating factors are present.

source.hint: This timeframe is consistent with the window used to ensure the immune system has regained functional status.
